articles.summary: Funding provided through the Bank's Community Development Partnership Program ISELIN, N.J., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Bank , a leading New Jersey-based financial institution, announced today that it has awarded $83,000 in grants to ten local non-profit organizations through its Community Development Partnership Program. The grants will advance financial literacy education, affordable housing, homeownership, and help meet the credit needs of the communities served. The Community Development Partnership Program builds on Provident Bank’s long record of working alongside non-profits to strengthen the communities it serves and foster lasting economic prosperity. Combined, the recipients of these major grants received a total of $83,000. The local non-profit organizations include: Central Jersey Housing Resource Center: Supports households facing challenges by helping them find safe, affordable housing that meets their needs.
